### What Does Jesus Expect from Us?
Author: Liz Curtis Higgs
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-march-17-2017.html
Passage: John 12:3
Points:
- Mary poured out an entire jar of costly perfume on Jesus' feet, keeping nothing back for herself.
- By drying His feet with her hair, she humbled herself and cast aside personal pride and social status.
- Her lavish sacrifice may cause believers to wonder if God expects them to give up everything.
- God only asks believers to offer back what He has already generously provided to them.
- Christ enables His followers to surrender their resources, talents, and lives with joy for His glory.

### Not What It Looks Like
Author: Greg Laurie
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/harvestdaily/greg-laurie-devotion-november-17-2022.html
Passage: John 12:3
Points:
- Mary performed an unexpected and extravagant act of devotion by anointing Jesus' feet with costly oil.
- Judas openly criticized the act as financially wasteful, cloaking his objection in fake concern for the poor.
- Scripture reveals that Judas was secretly a thief driven by greed rather than genuine compassion.
- Jesus commended Mary's sacrifice, silenced her critics, and affirmed the lasting significance of her deed.
- Spiritual realities often run counter to outward appearances, as true devotion can look foolish to self-serving observers.
